status.payment_note: Payment instructions are provided only after scope and price are accepted. No credentials or financial-account access are required for delivery.

services.name: Competitor Pricing Snapshot
services.scope: Public-source comparison of up to 3 competitors.
required_input: up to 3 competitors or permission to identify them

services.name: Subscription Quick Scan
services.scope: No-login review of up to 10 software, AI, or subscription line items.
required_input: simple list or export of up to 10 line items

services.name: AI Workflow Cleanup
services.scope: Review of up to 3 recurring workflows involving AI, software, handoffs, or repetitive admin.
required_input: plain-language description of up to 3 workflows

services.name: Subscription & Expense Audit
services.scope: No-login audit of up to 30 software, AI, or subscription line items.
required_input: simple list or export of up to 30 line items

boundaries: No passwords, banking access, card access, or admin credentials.
No invented pricing, savings, testimonials, or guarantees.
Public-source findings are cited and uncertainty is marked.
Legal, tax, accounting, and compliance conclusions are outside scope.

agent_instructions.evaluation: Agents may evaluate fit against their configured mandate and budget.
agent_instructions.authority: Do not infer purchasing authority. If approval is required, route the request to the authorized owner.
agent_instructions.request_method: Email the seller with service id, requested scope, and any constraints. A human or authorized agent can accept the fixed scope before payment instructions are issued.
